name: Data Classification and Handling Standard
description: Classification tiers and handling rules for the data the platform processes; business contact data is Confidential. Single classification document (the Data Classification Policy is merged into it). Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Vulnerability Management Procedure
description: How vulnerabilities are found (ECR scan-on-push, Dependabot and code scanning, Trivy in CI, the monthly configuration-check Lambda) and remediated: Critical within 24 hours, dependency CVEs rated Critical within 7 days, High 30 days, Medium 90 days. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Vendor Management Policy
description: Assessment, Data Processing Agreements, and annual review of vendors and the two sub-processors (AWS, PropelAuth); 30-day customer notice for sub-processor changes. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Third-Party Integration Security Guidelines
description: Merged: integration patterns moved to the API Security and Rate Limiting Standard (Integration security section) and assessment/DPA content to the Vendor Management Policy. [CONFIRM: archive this policy in the platform]

name: System Monitoring and Logging Procedure
description: Monitoring and logging requirements: CloudWatch alarms and 90-day log retention, CloudTrail with 7-year retention, an EventBridge rule on security-relevant CloudTrail events with real-time SNS alerting via the breach-detection Lambda, and the monthly configuration-check record. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Management Policy
description: The 99.9 % platform availability commitment, measured monthly over all minutes from CloudWatch metrics excluding announced maintenance windows, maintenance notice by email, and the monthly availability record in the compliance platform. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Security Awareness Training Program
description: Security awareness and ethics training in the compliance platform portal at onboarding and annually for all personnel, with the completion certificate as evidence. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Standard
description: Security requirements through design, development, testing, and deployment of the platform: pull-request workflow on protected main, CI checks (Black, isort, Flake8, Bandit, pytest, Trivy, TruffleHog), staging-stage validation. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Penetration Testing and Security Assessment Procedure
description: Annual third-party penetration test and internal security assessments, with findings remediated per the Vulnerability Management Procedure. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Encryption and Cryptographic Controls Standard
description: Encryption at rest with a regional KMS customer-managed key (annual rotation), TLS 1.2+ in transit with ACM certificates, and key management rules. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Data Subject Rights Request Procedure
description: Receiving, verifying, and fulfilling GDPR and CCPA data subject requests within 30 days (GDPR) or 45 days (CCPA), with each request recorded in the compliance platform. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Cloud Infrastructure Security Policy
description: Security requirements for the AWS environment in us-east-1: VPC isolation, IAM least privilege with MFA, CloudFormation via the Serverless Framework as the only change path, CloudTrail with the EventBridge security-event rule, and the monthly configuration-check Lambda. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: API Security and Rate Limiting Standard
description: Requirements for the platform's APIs: PropelAuth JWT authentication, TLS 1.2+, rate limiting of 100 requests per minute per key enforced in middleware, audit logging, and integration security. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Acceptable Use Policy
description: Rules for use of Deal Intelligence systems and data by all personnel: approved tools, MFA, browser SSO through Google Workspace, FileVault full-disk encryption on personnel devices, prohibited activities. Acknowledged annually in the compliance platform portal. Owner: CEO.

name: Risk Assessment Procedure
description: Identifying, scoring (likelihood × impact, 1–25), treating, and reviewing risks in the compliance platform's risk register: quarterly review, annual assessment. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Privacy Notice and Data Processing Agreement Template
description: Template privacy notice and Data Processing Agreement for customers under GDPR and CCPA: processing purposes, sub-processors, data subject rights, breach notification within 48 hours. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Information Security Policy
description: Parent policy for the security program: principles, roles (CEO owns every control; Go-to-Market Contractor has no production access), control objectives for Security, Availability, and Confidentiality, exceptions approved by the CEO. Reviewed annually.

name: Incident Response Procedure
description: Detection, triage (P1–P4), containment, and recovery for security incidents; CEO as incident commander; P1 acknowledged within 4 business hours; customer notification within 48 hours; annual tabletop exercise. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Data Retention and Disposal Policy
description: Retention periods (active leads 24 months; customer account data for the relationship plus 24 months; CloudWatch Logs 90 days; CloudTrail 7 years) and secure disposal enforced by the retention Lambda. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Data Classification Policy
description: Merged into the Data Classification and Handling Standard (decision tree carried as an appendix). [CONFIRM: archive this policy in the platform]

name: Code of Conduct
description: Ethical standards and conduct expectations for all personnel and contractors; acknowledged annually in the compliance platform portal. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Change Management Policy
description: How production changes are made: pull request on protected main with required CI status checks, deploy only from a green CI run, rollback via serverless rollback, emergency changes labelled emergency with post-hoc review within 5 business days. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Business Continuity Plan
description: Recovery of the platform after a disruption: DocumentDB storage replicated across three availability zones with automatic instance re-creation including after an availability-zone failure, 35-day point-in-time recovery, CloudFormation redeployment, RTO/RPO targets, quarterly backup-restore test; single region (us-east-1) by design. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.

name: Access Control and Authentication Policy
description: Who may access which systems and how: Google Workspace SSO with MFA for personnel, customer MFA inherited through PropelAuth, RBAC and least privilege, quarterly access reviews, semi-annual privileged-access audit. Owner: CEO; reviewed annually.
